description: This file defines the class Image_Canvas_PDF for handling PDF output in the Image_Canvas package, including methods for creating PDF documents, drawing shapes, adding text, overlaying images, and exporting the result.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_PDF
classes.description: A class extending Image_Canvas to provide PDF rendering capabilities using PDFlib, including methods for drawing shapes, text, images, and outputting the PDF.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_PDF
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PDF canvas with parameters such as page size, orientation, and PDF document handling.

methods.name: _getX
methods.description: Converts relative x-coordinate to absolute position based on left offset.

methods.name: _getY
methods.description: Converts relative y-coordinate to absolute position based on page height and top offset.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Converts a color input to an RGB array scaled between 0 and 1 for PDF use.

methods.name: _setLineStyle
methods.description: Sets the line style and width for drawing lines in the PDF.

methods.name: _setFillStyle
methods.description: Sets the fill style color for shapes in the PDF.

methods.name: _setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for text rendering in the PDF.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the PDF graphics state.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line in the PDF with specified parameters.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon shape, optionally closed, with fill and stroke styles.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with optional fill and stroke.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse or circle with fill and stroke.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice; implementation pending.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a text string in the current font.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the current font.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text at specified position with alignment and color options.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image at specified position with optional resizing and alignment.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the PDF to the browser and closes the document.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the PDF to a file specified in parameters.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Returns an HTML anchor tag linking to the generated PDF file.

methods.name: _version
methods.description: Detects the major version of PDFlib installed.
